additional_info.subject: Notes from RC
additional_info.body: Daniel tried to charge at the charging station, but charging was not possible. The screen showed that everything was checked, including the cable check, but after the cable check, it started checking everything again without starting the charge. Only after a restart was charging possible again.

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0412352-DC/Si-D/AT - [vn8H0d] Charging not started after cable check CRM:00796001440
additional_info.body:
Hello Johannes Dissauer,
Greetings of the day!
It may be due to the time taken for the voltage ramp-down after the cable check using powerline communication. After that, feedback is provided to the contactor to initiate the further process and start the charging session. It seems that there was a timeout or delay in this feedback process.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Kaushik Kumar
